title: MCP server workspace binding can be overridden per tool call
description: The MCP stdio server accepts --workspace at launch, but boundaryFromInput lets per-call workspaceRoot override that server option. The selected workspace also determines which on-disk CLI path is executed, so a project-scoped MCP server can be pointed at another local workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: When an MCP server is launched with workspaceRoot, tool-call workspaceRoot/projectRoot inputs must match it or be rejected.
Per-call registry entries cannot become trust anchors for unselected projects.
The MCP runner uses a trusted server-side CLI path rather than a client-selected workspace CLI path.
